audit_items.proof_trace: The code at L1006 checks `debt_value <= liquidation_params.close_factor_bypass_min_value` where `debt_value` is the ceiling-rounded USD value of the specific DebtType debt balance being liquidated — not `total_collateral_value` as the property assertion states. This is consistent with the documented design intent in LiquidationParams (L1081): 'close factor will not be enforce if the debt being liquidated has usd value less or equal to this value'. When the bypass applies (tiny dust debt), seized collateral is proportional to the small repayment amount (capped by the refund logic at L733-743), so no economic harm can result from the bypass.
